QuietCo

QuietCo makes vibration and acoustic instrumentation for precision manufacturing lines. Our sensors and analysis software sit alongside CNC and grinding equipment and detect the small changes in a machine's acoustic signature that precede a tolerance failure, usually several hundred parts before the first bad part is produced.

We have been in business since 2009 and sell mostly to automotive and aerospace tier-one suppliers in Germany, Japan and the United States.
